scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "npm run dev -w @hogulink/api" "npm run dev -w @hogulink/web"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w @hogulink/web
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run test:desktop && npm run test:demo-media && npm run build
scripts.test:desktop: node --import tsx --test scripts/desktop-model.test.ts scripts/consumer-model.test.ts scripts/discovery-model.test.ts scripts/therapist-directory-model.test.ts scripts/customer-flow-model.test.ts scripts/customer-api-session.test.ts scripts/coordination-model.test.ts scripts/invoice-model.test.ts scripts/reporting-model.test.ts scripts/promotion-model.test.ts scripts/service-availability.test.ts scripts/booking-presentation.test.ts scripts/customer-booking-data.test.ts scripts/partner-booking-data.test.ts scripts/service-mode-model.test.ts scripts/storefront-model.test.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write hogulink-api/src hogulink-api/test hogulink-web/src packages/contracts/src scripts docs README.md package.json
